rawModelPricing.telemetryRequirement: Every accepted raw-model response must record provider prompt_cache_hit_tokens and prompt_cache_miss_tokens; absence fails the cell.

Only the 121 successful stock cells are reused. The resume runner replaces every raw cell, retries only failed stock cells, and executes all Writer cells.

executionRule: Run both tracks from the frozen candidate source and task receipts. Preserve every failed cell.
